purpose: Prevent destructive reruns from overwriting valid committed proof artifacts with FAIL after route has advanced.
truth_boundary: Idempotent step guard build only. This builds a bounded guard that detects already-committed or out-of-phase reruns and prevents destructive proof overwrite. It returns ALREADY_COMMITTED_NOOP for safe reruns and blocks backward reruns that would corrupt proof state. It does not execute a tick, enable continuous loop, launch daemon, install scheduler, enable background loop, use network, widen queue, birth Entity/ANNA, approve final canon, or claim AGI.
